events.message: Service Worker registration blocked by Playwright

boundaries: Fresh anonymous Chrome context; no personal cookies, profile, or storage imported.
Only GET requests permitted; WebSocket and Service Worker blocked; no claim/login/order actions.
Production: every permitted GET uses real endpoints, with no authentication/API fixtures and ordinary TLS validation.
Mobile means 375px Chrome touch emulation, not physical-phone testing. Audio/device behavior is outside browser validation.
